questions.stem: Mr. X arrives at a tertiary care center with symptoms including a persistent cough and evening rise in temperature for the past two weeks. Suspecting tuberculosis (TB), the physician recommends a chest X-ray and a CBNAAT test. The CBNAAT (Cartridge Based Nucleic Acid Amplification Test) is a modern diagnostic tool used in the detection of TB. What type of method is CBNAAT an example of, particularly in the context of infectious diseases like tuberculosis?
